disclosures.name: TestDiff/Comparer/MapKeyPointer
disclosures.reason: runtime-capability: cmp sorts map keys that are pointers by reflect.Value.Pointer(). In go2cs, that value for a heap-allocated variable comes from the .NET identity hash of its box (golib ж.StandardBox.cs: PointerOrderToken is AllocationBase(RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(this))), which the runtime assigns from a pseudo-random sequence when it is first requested. So two boxes sort by that hash, not by the order they were allocated in. In Go, two consecutive allocations have ascending addresses, and cmp's expected report depends on that order. The keys and values match Go's; only the order of the two report lines differs. Measured identically in two runs (go-cmp v0.7.0, linux). This entry is removed if heap boxes are given pointer values in allocation order, which would add a cost to every box.
